cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(cxxshard CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(googletest URL https://github.com/google/googletest/archive/refs/tags/v1.15.2.tar.gz)
FetchContent_Declare(Catch2 GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2.git GIT_TAG v3.7.1 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(googletest Catch2)
add_executable(gt gt.cpp)
target_link_libraries(gt GTest::gtest_main)
add_executable(c2 c2.cpp)
target_link_libraries(c2 Catch2::Catch2WithMain)
